## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Remove built-in WarpGrep in favor of MCP server (tools, ~2h, CONSIDER)

- **What**: Kilo #13084 "refactor(cli): remove built-in WarpGrep" (PR https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13084, merged 2026-08-12, sha 5c97b48). Removed built-in WarpGrep tool implementation (packages/kilo-cli/src/tools/warpgrep/, 5 files, ~800 lines) and CLI command registration in favor of MCP-based warpgrep-server. WarpGrep now lives as standalone MCP server (mcp-servers/warpgrep-server/), reducing CLI bundle size and surface area. Users register it via mcp-servers.json instead of built-in tool. Rationale: MCP-first architecture for modular tool distribution, smaller CLI bundle, separate versioning for tools.
- **Why**: Alexi has built-in warpgrep tool (src/tool/tools/warpgrep.ts, ~4.7KB, 164 lines) for incremental grep with progress tracking (defineTool with Zod schema, registered via src/tool/registry.ts). Kilo's migration to MCP-based warpgrep demonstrates architecture direction: extract tools to standalone MCP servers for modularity, bundle size reduction, separate versioning. CONSIDER if we want to extract warpgrep to a standalone MCP server (MEDIUM effort, ~2h: extract warpgrep.ts to new packages/alexi-mcp-warpgrep/ or standalone repo, implement MCP server wrapper following MCP protocol, update docs to show mcp-servers.json registration, deprecate built-in tool with migration guide). Benefits: smaller CLI bundle (remove ~4.7KB), modular tool distribution (users opt-in via MCP config), consistent with upstream MCP-first architecture, separate versioning for warpgrep. Tradeoffs: requires MCP server packaging infrastructure, user migration path, no immediate user value (warpgrep works today). Size ~2h (extract tool logic, MCP server wrapper with protocol compliance, docs update, deprecation notice). Category: tools (MCP migration). Priority: CONSIDER (architecture alignment with Kilo upstream, bundle size reduction, modularity, but requires MCP packaging + user migration, no immediate feature value, MEDIUM effort for infrastructure work).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #13084 "refactor(cli): remove built-in WarpGrep" (merged 2026-08-12, sha 5c97b48). Full PR at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13084. Root cause: built-in WarpGrep bloated CLI bundle, coupling tool versioning to CLI releases. Fix: extract to mcp-servers/warpgrep-server/, remove packages/kilo-cli/src/tools/warpgrep/ (~800 lines), users register via mcp-servers.json. Benefit: modular tool distribution, smaller CLI bundle, MCP-first architecture.
- **Category**: tools (MCP migration). **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: CONSIDER (architecture alignment, bundle size, modularity, but requires MCP packaging + migration, no immediate user value).

#### 2. Reduce Windows CLI test contention (infra, ~3h, SKIP)

- **What**: Kilo #13077 "fix(ci): reduce Windows CLI test contention" (merged 2026-08-12, sha 4431875). Windows CLI unit tests ran 4-at-a-time on 4-vCPU runner (custom test-runner default = min(4, cpus)), oversubscribing CPU so heavy real-server test files blew per-test timeouts. Cap KILO_TEST_CONCURRENCY=2 on Windows (each file gets ~2 vCPU), grow Windows shards 4->6 to absorb lower per-shard parallelism, shard by observed duration instead of file size (two heaviest files no longer stack in one shard), raise per-file kill deadline to 600s (KILO_TEST_FILE_TIMEOUT, heaviest file ~270s, 30s under old 300s default). Scoped to @kilocode/cli custom runner on Windows only; Linux/macOS unchanged; non-CLI/core suite runs via plain 'bun test' and not affected.
- **Why**: Alexi has npm test (vitest run single pass, NOT watch), npm run test:coverage (required to pass CI, 40% lines enforced via jq on coverage/coverage-summary.json). No Windows-specific test concurrency tuning. Skip (CI stability fix for Kilo's Windows runner, no cross-cutting pattern for Alexi which runs Node/Linux/macOS CI, no Windows runner today, no custom test-runner with concurrency tuning, low signal).
- **Source**: Kilo commit sha 4431875 "fix(ci): reduce Windows CLI test contention" (merged 2026-08-12). Full commit at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4431875. Root cause: 4-at-a-time parallelism on 4-vCPU runner oversubscribed CPU, heavy files blew timeouts. Fix: KILO_TEST_CONCURRENCY=2 on Windows, 6 shards, duration-based sharding, 600s file timeout.
- **Category**: infra (CI). **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: SKIP (Kilo Windows CI stability, no Windows runner in Alexi, low signal).
